keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «처음에는 무서웠다» 와 «용기를 내서 뿌듯했다» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the first feeling (Ella is scared) and the final feeling (Ella is brave and proud). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: How does Ella feel at first?
boxes.a: Ella is scared, and her hands shake.

boxes.qen: How does Ella feel at the end?
boxes.a: Ella is brave and feels proud.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: She is scared, and her hands shake.
Ella takes a deep breath and opens her mouth.
the air you take into your body
in a soft and careful way
Ella feels proud because she is brave.
not afraid to do something hard

evs: She is scared, and her hands shake.
Ella has a dentist visit today.
The dentist checks her teeth gently.
It does not hurt at all!
why: «She is scared, and her hands shake.» 에서 엘라가 무서워서 손이 떨린다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
The sentence says she is scared, and her hands shake.

qs.q: "The dentist checks her teeth gently." What does "gently" mean here?
qs.qko: «The dentist checks her teeth gently.» 에서 «gently» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: It does not hurt at all!
Ella has a dentist visit today.
She is scared, and her hands shake.
Ella takes a deep breath and opens her mouth.
why: «It does not hurt at all!» 하나도 아프지 않았으니, 의사 선생님이 살살 조심히 봐 주었다는 뜻이에요.
It does not hurt at all, so the dentist checks her teeth softly and carefully.

qs.q: Why does Ella feel proud at the end?
opts: She is scared, but she is brave.
The dentist gives her a toy.
She does not go to the dentist.
evs: She is scared, and her hands shake.
Ella feels proud because she is brave.
Ella has a dentist visit today.
The dentist checks her teeth gently.
why: 처음에는 무서웠지만(«She is scared...») 용기를 냈기 때문에 뿌듯해요(«Ella feels proud because she is brave.»).
She is scared at first, but she is brave, so she feels proud.

ends: Ella goes back to the dentist next year and is not scared.
엘라는 다음 해에 다시 치과에 가고, 이번에는 무서워하지 않는다.
Ella helps her little brother at his first dentist visit.
엘라는 처음 치과에 가는 남동생을 도와준다.

write.src: “I think <u>Ella is brave</u> because <u>she opens her mouth</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
